Policies and Initiatives.title: Believe it or not: This AI minister is expecting... 83 AI kids
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Albania's AI Minister, Diella, is expecting 83 digital AI assistants to aid Socialist Party MPs. These AI tools will record parliamentary proceedings, update officials, and suggest debate strategies to enhance governance and combat corruption. The initiative is expected to be fully functional by late 2026.

Major AI Developments.title: State mandates face recognition for rural employment schemes
Major AI Developments.summary: A state government has mandated the use of face recognition technology for rural employment schemes. This move aims to enhance the authenticity and transparency of the schemes, although the specific state and details of implementation are not provided. The introduction of face recognition is intended to improve the overall management of rural employment programs.

Major AI Developments.title: Indo-German AI innovation lab launches at IIEST Shibpur for MSME growth
Major AI Developments.summary: The Indo-German Living Lab Initiative has been launched at IIEST Shibpur in collaboration with GIZ Germany to promote AI-driven partnerships between academia and industry. The initiative aims to boost collaboration between Indian and German SMEs, research bodies, and industries, with a focus on smart manufacturing and sustainable growth. This partnership is expected to drive MSME growth through innovative technologies and international cooperation.

Major AI Developments.title: Women in 2026 assembly elections; Building AI tool for healthcare
Major AI Developments.summary: West Bengal, a state with a strong record of women's representation, elected 37 women in the 2026 assembly elections. The state is also working on building an AI tool for healthcare, although details of the project are not specified. The election results highlight the state's continued progress in promoting women's participation in politics.

Major AI Developments.title: ML questions Bengal, Tamil Nadu poll results
Major AI Developments.summary: The CPI(ML) has expressed dissatisfaction with the recent election results in West Bengal and Tamil Nadu, citing significant voter roll purges as a factor in their losses. The party claims that millions of voters were unjustly removed, which contributed to the BJP's success in Bengal and other electoral outcomes. The CPI(ML) is questioning the legitimacy of the results due to these alleged purges.

Major AI Developments.title: Apna Mart lays off 10% of workforce, shifts base from Bengaluru to Gurugram
Major AI Developments.summary: Apna Mart, a grocery delivery startup, has laid off around 10% of its workforce, impacting 35-40 employees, as part of a restructuring exercise linked to AI adoption. The company is relocating its base from Bengaluru to Gurugram, with product and technology teams already moved. The layoffs were due to AI-led automation making some roles redundant and relocation not being feasible for certain employees.

Major AI Developments.title: EC set to use AI tech to monitor polling booths
Major AI Developments.summary: The Election Commission (EC) is set to utilize AI technology to monitor polling booths. This initiative aims to enhance the surveillance and security of the voting process. The EC will leverage AI to ensure fair and transparent elections.

Major AI Developments.title: Alumnus’s son pledges 15cr to IIT-Kgp to launch AI centre for mining solutions
Major AI Developments.summary: An alumnus's son has pledged 15 crore to IIT-Kharagpur to establish an AI centre focused on mining solutions. The centre aims to leverage artificial intelligence to improve mining operations and outcomes. This significant donation will support the development of innovative technologies and research in the field of mining.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Kharagpur launches Rs 15 cr AI centre for mining innovation
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Kharagpur has launched a new AI centre with a budget of Rs 15 crore to drive innovation in the mining sector. The centre aims to leverage artificial intelligence for advancements in mining technology. This initiative is expected to enhance mining operations and safety through AI-powered solutions.

Major AI Developments.title: Netting hilsa with AI: Smart maps locate rich zones but raise overfishing concerns
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI-powered forecasting system called XGBoost has been launched to help fishers locate hilsa shoals in the Bay of Bengal by analyzing environmental data. The system, developed by INCOIS, aims to boost catches by predicting fish-rich zones. However, its introduction has raised concerns about sustainability and potential overfishing among some fishing communities.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT-Kgp launches online programmes on AI, ML
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Kharagpur has launched online programs focused on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). The institute aims to provide accessible education on these emerging technologies through its online platform. The launch is part of the institute's efforts to expand its educational offerings and cater to a wider audience.

Major AI Developments.title: Abhishek flays Kabir on home turf. Don’t fall for AI clips: PM
Major AI Developments.summary: Prime Minister Abhishek criticized Kabir on his home turf, warning people not to fall for AI-generated clips. The PM's statement comes as a caution against the spread of misinformation through artificial intelligence. Abhishek's warning highlights the potential risks of AI-generated content.

Major AI Developments.title: West Bengal polls: PM Modi accuses TMC of AI conspiracy, promises UCC
Major AI Developments.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi accused the Trinamool Congress (TMC) of using AI-generated fake videos as part of a conspiracy ahead of the West Bengal polls. He made these comments while addressing a rally in Jangipur, Murshidabad. Modi also promised to implement the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) in the state.

Major AI Developments.title: Firms take on AI chatbots in visibility fight
Major AI Developments.summary: Indian businesses are preparing for legal battles due to AI platforms altering online information discovery, potentially leading to lost traffic. A case in the Calcutta High Court has raised concerns over selective exclusion from AI responses. Experts predict a surge in lawsuits as companies fight for visibility and fair treatment in the evolving digital landscape.

Major AI Developments.title: Magical Nest operator Raanro raises pre-seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Raanro Interior Technology, the parent company of Magical Nest, has raised Rs 4.12 crore in a pre-seed funding round at a pre-money valuation of Rs 60 crore. The round was participated by Stargazer Fund and several angel investors, including Kunal Shah and Ankit Nagori. The company will use the funds to develop an AI-powered platform for streamlining interior design workflows.

Major AI Developments.title: LTM Partners with IIT Kharagpur to Upskill Its Workforce in AI
Major AI Developments.summary: LTM has partnered with the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) to upskill its workforce in artificial intelligence (AI). This partnership aims to enhance the skills of LTM's employees in AI and related technologies. The collaboration is expected to drive innovation and growth within the company.

Major AI Developments.title: Alumnus gifts IIT-Kgp 46cr to set up digi-engg-AI school
Major AI Developments.summary: An alumnus of IIT-Kgp has donated 46 crore to establish a school focused on digital engineering and artificial intelligence. The gift is intended to support the development of a new academic program at the institution. The donation is expected to enhance the university's capabilities in emerging technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT Kharagpur to offer BS in AI & data science in Bangla from 2026 session
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Kharagpur will offer a Bachelor of Science degree in AI and data science, with courses taught in Bengali, starting from the 2026 academic session. This initiative aims to increase accessibility to these fields for students who are more comfortable with the Bengali language. The program is set to begin in 2026, marking a significant step in making AI and data science education more inclusive.

Major AI Developments.title: Google Gemini launches JEE Main mock test papers: IIT Kharagpur alumnus Sundar Pichai goes nostalgic, ‘If I could…’
Major AI Developments.summary: Google Gemini has launched free mock JEE Main test papers that simulate real exam conditions, offering instant performance analysis and personalized study plans. The launch was celebrated by Sundar Pichai, an IIT Kharagpur alumnus, who expressed nostalgia and appreciation for the initiative. The AI platform aims to support students preparing for the JEE Main exam with its innovative features.

AI Start-Up News.title: DAAKit raises $138K in pre-seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: DAAKit, a hyperlocal fulfillment and last-mile logistics startup, has raised $138K in a pre-seed funding round led by Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to expand operations, launch new dark stores, and strengthen its technology infrastructure and team. DAAKit was founded in 2024 and operates an asset-light logistics model, currently serving cities including Delhi, Gurugram, and Mumbai.

AI Start-Up News.title: Aquapulse raises Rs 25 Cr in Series A led by NABVENTURES
AI Start-Up News.summary: Aquapulse, an aquaculture tech startup, has raised Rs 25 crore in a Series A round led by NABVENTURES. The funds will be used to expand its farmer network, set up a processing facility, and enhance its technology stack, including AI-led systems. Founded in 2022, Aquapulse aims to improve efficiency in the seafood value chain through its operations in aquaculture, infrastructure, and technology.

AI Start-Up News.title: Exclusive: PhysicsWallah co-founder Prateek Boob set to invest in Newton School
AI Start-Up News.summary: Newton School, a certification-based technical training platform, is set to raise around Rs 25 crore in fresh funding from Prateek Boob, co-founder of PhysicsWallah, as part of an extension of its Series B round. The investment will be made through the issue of 72,738 Series B1 preference shares at Rs 3,437 per share. This funding comes after a gap of nearly four years for the Gurugram-based company.

AI Start-Up News.title: US firm eyes Bengal startup JVs for AI-led transformation
AI Start-Up News.summary: A US firm is looking to form joint ventures with startups in Bengal to drive AI-led transformation. The company aims to leverage the region's talent pool and innovative ecosystem to accelerate its growth. This partnership is expected to bring about significant technological advancements and economic benefits to the region.
